name: ihern
description: IHERN websites: the main site and the blog, in one repository

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/main && npm run build -w apps/blog
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/main && npm run lint -w apps/blog
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/main && tsc --noEmit -p apps/blog && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core
